product_metadata.title: Soft Silky Satin Solid Mocha Brown 4pc Deep Pocket Sheet Set for King Bed
features: 1 Piece Flat Sheet 90 x 100. 1 Piece Fitted Sheet 78 x 80. 2 Piece Pillowcases 20 x 40
Deep Pocket - Up to 16 inches deep pocket that will fit a wide range of mattresses.
350 thread count King sheet set- Seamless, soft and smoothness.
Elastic Band - At each corner to secure the sheet in proper place to your mattress.
Fabric Content:100 % Polyester. Easy Care- Machine Washable.
description: Give in to an enchanted night's sleep with this luxurious set of satin sheets for King beds in high-fashion burgundy red. This set includes a flat sheet, fitted sheet, and two King pillowcases. Smooth and silky with a lustrous sheen, these satin sheets are made of 100 percent woven polyester satin. The fitted sheets feature elastic corners for a secure fit and 14-inch pockets that can fit mattresses up to 16 inches deep. They're machine washable for easy care.
